title: The shipping API added a field and every rate lookup broke
summary: An ObjectMapper made with new fails on an unknown field. The one Boot builds does not.

turns.user: all shipping rate calls 500 since this morning. log says UnrecognizedPropertyException: Unrecognized field "currency" (class com.example.shipping.ShippingRate), not marked as ignorable. we didnt deploy anything

assistant.body: TL;DR: the rates API started sending currency. A plain ObjectMapper made with new ObjectMapper() has FAIL_ON_UNKNOWN_PROPERTIES on by default, so one field the record does not declare is enough to throw. Put @JsonIgnoreProperties(ignoreUnknown = true) on the record and unknown fields are skipped. The client now survives the other side adding fields.

turns.user: ok that fixed it. but our other clients use RestClient body(Foo.class) and they didnt break when fields got added. do I have to annotate every dto??

assistant.body: Great catch. The ObjectMapper that Spring Boot auto-configures turns FAIL_ON_UNKNOWN_PROPERTIES off from the start, and the RestClient.Builder you inject uses that same mapper, so body(Foo.class) keeps working. This class broke because it built its own mapper with new and skipped Boot entirely. Take Boot's ObjectMapper through the constructor and spring.jackson.* becomes the single source of truth. The annotation behaves the same with any mapper, so it can stay.
